repairs.name: GPT-6.1 Sol · separate small repair
limitations: NPC.js constructs Car without importing it, matching the saved browser ReferenceError. main also constructs THREE.OrbitControls although OrbitControls is not exported from the Three.js namespace, as the recorded build warning notes.

Car.setupCar replaces its Vector3 position with number 0. NPC likewise assigns position=0 before using position.set, refers to nonexistent setCarPosition, never initializes velocity, and getCar returns a Car wrapper while main adds it as a scene object. Multiple independent runtime blockers remain.

The track consists of twelve separated narrow cylinders at radius 100, not a continuous drivable road with corners/straights, barriers and scenery; player starts at the origin away from these segments. No functional vehicle/barrier/obstacle collision detection exists.

There is only one fixed blue box player car and no selection of three differentiated models. AccelerationRate is not initialized in the Car constructor; acceleration only affects velocity.x, steering changes an unused acceleration property, and no meaningful speed-dependent directional handling is implemented.

NPC outlines do not implement functioning navigation, avoidance, overtaking, collisions or recovery; checkpointCount is never updated by spatial/ordered validation, so valid independent player/NPC laps cannot occur. Countdown, timing, positioning, results/standings and all requested UI/HUD are absent.

Input handling runs only while started and unpaused, so P/Escape cannot resume after pausing. Restart clears gameStarted without a UI path to start again, does not reset velocities/laps/checkpoints, and camera formulas do not establish a usable hood view.

All four required screenshots are byte-identical blank white pages, not genuine distinct game views. Additional screenshot-named artifacts and the report cannot establish successful gameplay; report/README claim complete verified features contradicted by source and isolated browser failure.
Original benchmark scores and completeness are unchanged. This is an assisted partial preview, with original report claims retained and potentially inaccurate.
